text:
Mornings don't usually feel this mild in late October, and it's only going to get warmer: we're clear and 50 already, with sunshine and a south breeze pushing us to a high near 65 this afternoon. That breeze runs 12 to 16 mph with gusts close to 30, and with all the dry leaves around, fire danger is elevated. A special weather statement is in effect until 8:15 tonight, so skip the backyard burning.

A weak cold front brings clouds and a slight chance of a few showers between 8 and 10 tonight. NWS and the American model barely see it, but the European model is much wetter, so tuck an umbrella nearby if you're out this evening. Even then, we're talking a few hundredths up to a tenth of an inch, nowhere near a soaking. Tonight stays mild, around 49.

Friday turns cooler behind the front, partly sunny with a high near 56 and a northwest breeze gusting to about 25. Saturday is sunny and cooler yet, mid 40s to low 50s, so Halloween trick-or-treaters want a layer under the costume. Wear a jacket Friday, and enjoy today's warmth while it lasts.
